name: Greenhouse Effects
dirt_evidence: Goldrive; Goldrive XL; Finger Fuzz; Jurassic Fuzz; Outlier; Roots Fuzz; Double Edged; Self-Titled modular platform
notes: Timeline states first working pedal October 2004, first Goldrive sold March 2005, first dealer 2007, studio opened 2009, and full-time operation October 2009. 2014 Self-Titled should be treated as a modular platform, not as many independent permanent models.

name: Bearfoot FX
dirt_evidence: Honey Bee; Honey Beest; Dyna Red; Candy Apple/Gated/Candiru; Arctic White; Gnarwahl; Uber Bee and more
notes: Effects Database identifies BearFoot as collaboration between DonnerBox and BJF Electronics, run by Donner Rusk. Opened for business February 22, 2011. Preserve BJF Electronics and BearFoot retail identities separately.

name: Tom's Line Engineering
dirt_evidence: AOD-1; ADT-1; AMD-1 Metal; ABS-1 Blues
notes: 2013 Musikmesse records establish early mini-pedal dirt family. Effects Database links Tom's Line Engineering to Aroma. Physical manufacturing/brand relationship should remain separate from later Aroma-branded products until fully reconciled.

name: Hotone Audio
dirt_evidence: Skyline Fury; Dirty Boy; later Nano/Skyline and hybrid dirt products
notes: 2013 Musikmesse/NAMM presence establishes early mini-pedal commercial corridor. Catalog has expanded far beyond dirt, so central archive should retain dirt-specific records and scope boundaries.

name: Mid-Fi Electronics
dirt_evidence: Demo Tape Fuzz; Fuzz Wall; Magick I; Overdrive; Peace Gun and more
notes: Doug Tuttle timeline states pedal building began 1997, RNG appeared 2001, profit sales began 2003. Early documented dirt products predate the later 2010s catalog and warrant deeper chronological completion.
